sandeep: Link? short summary?

laura: Internal link: https://internal.redwood/team/private/sla-fallback (internal only). TL;DR: if p95 > configured SLO for 10m and degradation is our allocation/fallback path, we do 3 steps: auto-fallback to compatible variant, 30m temporary burst if capacity exists, then pro-rata SLA credit if unresolved.

maria_security: Note: telemetry + audit logs must be enabled for automated validation. If disabled, credits require manual review and will take longer. Add to onboarding checklist.
